record.question: In ureterosigmoidostomy all occur EXCEPT
record.explanation: The PDF (General Surgery Paper-IV, October 2022, Q23) asks which finding does NOT occur after ureterosigmoidostomy. Hyperchloremic acidosis and hypokalemia are the classic consequences of chloride-for-bicarbonate exchange and potassium loss in the colon, and hyperchloremia is part of that picture, leaving hyponatremia as the least typical finding; the classic association is less firm, so confidence is medium.
